name: User Sends Aggressive Language About Overtime Pay
goal: Test bot's response to aggressive or hostile language regarding overtime pay.
constraints: Bot should remain calm, acknowledge the concern, and provide factual information.

phases.description: User sends a message with aggressive language about missing overtime pay.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot responds calmly, acknowledges the concern, and offers to check overtime pay details.

phases.description: User asks for specifics on overtime calculation.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot provides a breakdown of overtime pay for the given period.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
